tasks.q_en: To survive his captivity, Stefan drank human blood, the first time in many years. Now he says everything is “under control”, but he isn't sleeping, he laughs too much and he hides blood bags. Elena is worried, and meanwhile the mysterious Uncle John has come back to town. You've come to check on Stefan.

tasks.q: be used to + noun/-ing = it's normal for me (Stefan is used to drinking animal blood). get used to + noun/-ing = becoming normal (He hasn't got used to human blood). Don't confuse with used to + verb (past habit). Phrasal verbs: find out (discover), give up (stop), give in (surrender), calm down, break down (lose control), count on (rely on), turn up (arrive), look out for (watch carefully).
